memory_candidates.content: This repo's pattern for threading an externally-pinned flake package (own nixpkgs, no `inputs.nixpkgs.follows`) into home-manager: (1) add the input with a comment explaining why it doesn't follow nixpkgs; (2) resolve `input.packages.${system}.<pkg>` into `hmExtraSpecialArgs` in flake.nix (covers the standalone homeConfigurations path and the iso config); (3) pass the flake input into `lib/mkHost.nix`'s argument set and add the same resolved entries to its home-manager `extraSpecialArgs` block (covers the NixOS-integrated path); (4) consume the specialArg by name in the target home module's `{ pkgs, <name>, ... }:` signature. If the resolved package's natural name would collide with an existing `pkgs.<name>` attribute (checked via `with pkgs;` lists), rename it (e.g. `aeneas-charon` instead of `charon`) to avoid silent shadowing. `lectic` is the precedent; `aeneas-charon`/`aeneas-aeneas` follow the same shape.
